leadText:
School of Hard Knocks (Japanese: VS プロトーガ VS Tirtouga), titled VS Tirtouga in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 499th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 39th chapter of the .

It is subtitled Tirtouga (Japanese: 暴走 Wild-riding) in the VIZ Media translation and School of Hard Knocks in the Shogakukan Asia translation.
